card.text: TOI-3757 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.quote: TOI-3757 b is a gas giant exoplanet located in the constellation of Auriga 578 light years, or 177 parsecs, away from Earth.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around TOI-3757. Its orbit and size follow Kanodia et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
